Learning applied: rules 1 (short, payoff early), 2 (viewer's own life), 5 (series promise inside 20 s), 6 (everyday-tech first), 7 (Space second). Timely check: Mars passes Regulus today but the Mars-Jupiter peak (16-22 Nov) and the supermoon (24 Nov) have passed, so no strong free timely hook; slot 2 stays a Space series follow-up. Candidates (/40: curiosity, personal relevance, visual, proof): (1) how does your phone know which way is up 33 (series follow-up of the 25 Nov proximity video), (2) why does your charger get warm 30, (3) how does a touchscreen feel your finger 29, (4) why does airplane mode exist 28, (5) how does a fingerprint reader work 28. Winner: (1). Titles (/50): 'How Does Your Phone Know Which Way Is Up?' 44 (chosen, 41 chars), 'The Tiny Sensor That Feels Gravity' 40, 'Why Your Phone Screen Rotates (The Secret)' 38. Thumbnails: A tilted phone with arrows and the question (chosen), B a speck on springs, C two phones. Hooks: 'Turn your phone sideways and the screen follows. How does it know which way is up?' (chosen), 'There is a speck of silicon in your phone that leans when you tilt it.', 'Your phone knows up even in the dark.'. SEO (seo-research.yml 26 Nov): see data/seo/latest.json queries 'how does my phone know which way is up' / 'why does my phone screen rotate'; the phrase 'which way is up' is used in the title. Gap: results are mostly developer docs and repair guides; none tells it as a story in under a minute (speck on springs, gravity sensor + gyroscope blend, why the screen waits). Claims: (1) a MEMS accelerometer is a tiny mass on springs in silicon; a phone at rest reads about 1 g on the axis opposing gravity, which tells it which way is down (DigiKey sensor article, maketecheasier) - VERIFIED; (2) the gyroscope measures rotation rate and can drift because it tracks change not absolute direction (Android developer docs, DigiKey) - VERIFIED; (3) phones fuse accelerometer + gyroscope (+ magnetometer) readings; no single filter is universal (DigiKey, escholarship paper) - VERIFIED, narration says 'blends' without naming a filter; (4) filtering with a minimum duration stops the screen flipping on brief wobbles (Android Developers blog 'one screen turn deserves another') - VERIFIED; (5) 'smaller than rice' for the sensing speck/chip - PARTIALLY VERIFIED (MEMS structures are micrometre scale; the chip is millimetres), used in the on-screen chat only; the narration says 'a speck of silicon'. Sources: https://android-developers.googleblog.com/2010/09/one-screen-turn-deserves-another.html https://www.digikey.com/en/articles/android-as-a-sensor-platform-in-phones-tablets-and-ereaders https://developer.android.com/develop/sensors-and-location/sensors/sensors_motion Growth: lever = series follow-up (Phone Secrets part 2 with the promise in scene 2, part three asked for in the pinned comment) and retention (payoff 'speck on springs' by second ~14); policy check: own angle and structure (a how-it-works mystery with a sensor-blend payoff), different from the what-if and the rules story of the day, no health/finance claims. scenes.text: Turn your phone sideways and the screen follows. How does it know which way is up?
Phone Secrets, part two. In this video you'll see the tiny sensor that feels gravity.
Inside is a speck of silicon on microscopic springs. Tilt the phone, and it leans.
That lean becomes a tiny electrical signal, telling the phone where gravity pulls.
A gyroscope adds how fast you turn. It's quick, but it slowly drifts.
So the phone blends them: gravity keeps it honest, the gyroscope keeps it fast.
Why does the screen wait before flipping? It ignores wobbles, so it won't flip every shake.
Your phone knows up, even in the dark. What should part three explain? Tell me below!

scenes.text: फ़ोन आड़ा करो तो स्क्रीन घूम जाती है। उसे कैसे पता कि ऊपर कौन-सा है?
फ़ोन सीक्रेट्स, भाग दो। इस वीडियो में आप देखेंगे वह सेंसर जो गुरुत्व महसूस करता है।
अंदर बारीक स्प्रिंग पर सिलिकॉन का एक कण है। फ़ोन झुकाओ तो वह झुकता है।
वह झुकाव बिजली का नन्हा संकेत बन जाता है, जो बताता है खिंचाव किधर है।
जाइरोस्कोप बताता है आप कितनी तेज़ घूमे। वह फुर्तीला है, पर धीरे-धीरे भटकता है।
इसलिए फ़ोन दोनों को मिलाता है: गुरुत्व उसे सही रखता है, जाइरोस्कोप तेज़।
स्क्रीन पलटने से पहले रुकती क्यों है? वह हिलावट अनदेखी करती है, ताकि हर झटके पर न पलटे।
फ़ोन अँधेरे में भी जानता है ऊपर कहाँ है। भाग तीन में क्या समझाऊँ? नीचे बताइए!
